title: The 80/20 Rule
description: 80% of your revenue comes from 20% of your clients. Focus on your top-tier leads today.

title: Objection Handling
description: When a client says 'I need to think', they usually mean 'I don't see the value yet'. Re-state the ROI.

title: The Power of Follow-up
description: Most sales happen after the 5th contact. Don't let your follow-up queue grow cold.

title: Emotional Connection
description: People buy based on emotion and justify with logic. Connect with their financial goals first.

title: Time is Money
description: The faster you respond to a 'Fresh' lead, the higher your conversion probability. Speed is key.
